.. change::
    :tags: feature, orm, asyncio
    :tickets: 13605

    Added :meth:`_orm.Session.post_commit`, which registers a zero-
    argument callback to be invoked only after the outermost database
    transaction has committed successfully.  Callbacks are associated with
    the transaction level in which they are registered: callbacks
    registered within a SAVEPOINT that is later rolled back are discarded,
    while those within a successfully released SAVEPOINT are merged into
    the enclosing transaction and run only if the outer transaction
    commits.  Registration order is preserved.  If a callback raises after
    the (already irreversible) commit, the exception is wrapped in
    :class:`_orm.exc.PostCommitCallbackError` to make clear that the
    database commit has already occurred.  For
    :class:`_asyncio.AsyncSession`,
    :meth:`_asyncio.AsyncSession.post_commit` additionally accepts
    coroutine functions and other callables returning awaitables.
